instruction: Create an ORIGINAL PURE-DART reusable package named aivexus_interleave_lists, Dart SDK >=3.3.0 <4.0.0. Implement exactly this PUBLIC TOP-LEVEL Dart function in lib/interleave_lists.dart: List<int> interleaveIntegers(List<int> left, List<int> right). Return a new list alternating elements from left and right starting with left, appending any remainder from the longer list in original order. Handle empty inputs and signed values; never mutate either input. Fully implement working behavior yourself, not a stub. Write reasonable tests under test/. You may use Dart core List, Map, Set, loops and standard library methods only. No third-party runtime dependencies, networking, filesystem, FFI, shell or privileged APIs. Always use valid Dart SDK APIs and compileable types. Return the strict JSON source object requested by the system prompt.
